evidence.unit: Application-wide count buckets under the operational policy (DL-083, DL-089, DL-401, DL-2450)
evidence.quote:
- An EventRecord with `scope_kind=application` and `event_type` `auth.github.device_code.issued`, `auth.github.token.polling`, `auth.github.authenticated`, `auth.github.failed` or `auth.github.disconnected` counts in `app:github_sign_in`. DL-401 gives these five Application-only families this dedicated count. The registered histories select `RP-OPERATIONAL-SECURITY-APPLICATION-2555D@1.0.0` under SP-670.
- An EventRecord with `scope_kind=application` and `event_type=filesafe.policy_degraded` counts in `app:filesafe_policy_degraded` under DL-2450 and SP-556. Its Project edition counts in its Project partition.

Only the exact Application families and the Boot aggregate control named above count in these application-wide buckets. A record whose scope or event type is unknown or unregistered is quarantined before append (DL-031 `EVT-05`) and never defaulted into a bucket.

**Count and overflow.** Each application-wide bucket retains at most 2,000,000 records, counting every record in the bucket whichever of its families wrote it, in the existing count order `(retention_anchor_at_utc, sequence_id?, stable_object_id)`. For `app:storage_operational`, `app:platform_capability` and `app:filesafe_policy_degraded`, expiry is inclusive at the terminal-transition anchor plus 220,752,000 seconds. The GitHub sign-in bucket follows SP-670 for its retention anchor and expiry. Compaction removes only expired unheld records. Holds and stronger references override age and count. Overflow fails closed, as for a Project: when a new record would take its bucket past 2,000,000 and no expired unheld member remains to compact, that record is refused and nothing is written. A full bucket never evicts an unexpired or held record, never borrows room from another bucket and never refuses a record of another bucket. Platform evaluations therefore cannot use up the room kept for recovery records (DL-089), sign-in records cannot use up the room of either (DL-401), and FileSafe degradation records cannot use up the room of any other bucket (DL-2450). No application-wide bucket affects a Project bucket.
